name: io.kiloiot/kilo
title: Kilo IoT Platform
description: Operate a live IoT deployment from your own AI client: read telemetry and device state, provision devices, build rules and alarms, and run a device's already-configured commands on real hardware. Browser sign-in; the connection carries exactly your permissions and organization scope.

organizationId.description: Pin the connection to one organization instead of following the one selected in the Kilo web app. Find the ID in the web app; you must be a member of it.
